name: v118_model_social_vwap_eventful
hypothesis: Daily model-score deterioration combined with positive social attention and close-below-VWAP pressure may create a short-cycle signal away from slow accounting and competitor sleeves.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) > 0.55, 0.250 * rank(-1 * multi_factor_acceleration_score_derivative) + 0.200 * rank(-1 * cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.140 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 20)) + 0.070 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)

name: v118_revision_pcr_skew_eventful
hypothesis: Analyst-revision rank deterioration plus a smoother PCR-volume term and short option-skew relief may capture eventful expectation reset without using sales/PCR-open-interest sleeves.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) > 0.55, 0.340 * rank(-1 * analyst_revision_rank_derivative) + 0.210 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(pcr_vol_20 - pcr_vol_180), 90), industry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * implied_volatility_mean_skew_20, 60), industry) + 0.160 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_60_days, 60), industry), -1)

name: v118_social_skew_vwap_lowvol
hypothesis: Low-volume days may let social sentiment and option-skew term-structure dislocation mean-revert before the crowded option/reversal sleeves dominate.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(volume / adv20, 20) < 0.65, 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.210 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(implied_volatility_mean_skew_20 - implied_volatility_mean_skew_120), 90), industry) + 0.160 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 20)) + 0.110 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.070 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_60_days_spy, 60), industry), -1)

name: v118_pcrvol_model_social_eventful
hypothesis: PCR volume term structure is occupied alone, but adding model-score and social confirmation on eventful days may separate it from the old PCR/OI and option-breakeven sleeves.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) > 0.55, 0.300 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(pcr_vol_20 - pcr_vol_180), 90), industry) + 0.190 * rank(-1 * multi_factor_static_score_derivative) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.160 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_bfl_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.110 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.060 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)

name: v118_long_option_breakeven_social
hypothesis: Long-dated option breakeven versus short-dated breakeven may express slower expectation convexity; social and model confirmation may keep it distinct from call-put 60d sleeves.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) > 0.55, 0.280 * group_rank(ts_rank((option_breakeven_720 - option_breakeven_60) / close, 90), industry) + 0.180 * rank(-1 * cashflow_efficiency_rank_derivative) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.130 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 20)) + 0.080 * rank(-(close / open - 1)), -1)

name: v118_growth_certainty_volume_lowcorr
hypothesis: Growth-potential and earnings-certainty rank changes are model-derived rather than accounting-level fields; pairing them with volume exhaustion under low market-correlation may expose a different short-cycle model path.
expression: trade_when(correlation_last_60_days_spy < correlation_last_360_days_spy, 0.300 * rank(-1 * growth_potential_rank_derivative) + 0.250 * rank(-1 * earnings_certainty_rank_derivative) + 0.200 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10)) + 0.150 * rank(-(close / open - 1)) + 0.100 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)

name: v118_relative_value_social_highabs

expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) > 0.55, 0.320 * rank(-1 * relative_valuation_rank_derivative) + 0.200 * rank(-1 * multi_factor_static_score_derivative) + 0.190 * group_rank(ts_rank(snt_social_value_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 60), industry) + 0.090 * rank(-1 * ts_rank((close - vwap) / close, 20)) + 0.050 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 90), industry), -1)
